title: TC-TIB-026 — [Happy path] Bulk action: parallel thumbnail upload + bulk delete inline items
steps:
Preconditions: Global Option (Additional Option, source = Create new) with 3+ items

  1. Use Bulk action to upload thumbnails for multiple items at once (including triggering parallel uploads)
  2. Use Bulk action again to select and delete multiple items
  3. Save
expectedResult: All thumbnails upload and attach to the correct items with no mix-up between parallel uploads; bulk-selected items are removed correctly; remaining items/display unaffected.
actualResult:
Environment: staging-portal.teeinblue.com, store linh-tib-staging.myshopify.com. GO 986, 5 items at start (Blue, Green, XSS-payload, ItemA, ItemB).

Observed (direct) — bulk thumbnail upload: Bulk action > "Upload thumbnails" opens a dialog: "Upload files with filenames that match existing additional option names to replace the current thumbnails." Uploaded 2 distinctly-colored PNGs named exactly ItemA.png and ItemB.png in one multi-file selection — dialog reported "2 file(s) matched with existing additional option items", confirmed Upload. DOM check after: ItemA's thumbnail URL and ItemB's thumbnail URL are two different, item-specific uploaded images (not swapped) — also visually confirmed via screenshot (ItemA shows the orange swatch, ItemB shows the purple swatch, matching the uploaded files). No mix-up between the parallel uploads.

Observed (direct) — bulk delete: Bulk action > "Delete items" switched the item list into selection mode (checkbox per item + "N selected" counter + Delete button). Selected ItemA and ItemB (counter showed "2 selected"), clicked Delete → confirm dialog "Are you sure you want to delete 2 item(s)?" → confirmed. Result: "Additional Options (3)" — only ItemA and ItemB were removed; Blue, Green, and the XSS-payload item were left untouched. Saved successfully.

Conclusion (direct observation): Both bulk thumbnail upload (parallel, correctly matched by filename) and bulk delete (correct subset removed, others unaffected) work as expected.
